title: Warranty Coverage Claims Adjudication Standard
content:
**Standard.** A Warranty Coverage claim names one component and the units affected and is decided within the plan's decision window. A claim is decided only while the registration status is active or transfer pending. A claim is considered under the terms only when it is filed no later than the notice window after the date the customer first noticed the problem. Calendar days are counted from the day after the date the customer first noticed the problem, and filing on the last day of the window is on time. The component's term and the labor term are each judged on the claim filing date against the coverage start date, with the rental cap and, for a transferred registration, the transferred caps applied first. A claim whose cause is one of the exclusions is denied for an excluded cause whatever the term; seal failure means visible fogging or film between the panes, and room-side condensation is never a defect. A cosmetic defect present at installation is considered only when reported within the cosmetic window after the coverage start date. Inside both the component and labor terms the decision is approved for parts and labor; inside the component term but past the labor term it is approved for parts only; past the component term it is denied as out of term. An insulated glass claim whose full years since coverage start reach a proration step with a customer share above zero is approved with proration. Installation workmanship is judged on the workmanship term alone.

## Preconditions and their evidence

| Condition | Evidence | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Registration in force | the registration's status is active or transfer pending | system record |
| Claim filed in time | the date the customer first noticed the problem, as recorded on the claim, and the claim's filing date | the claim record, the noticed date being the customer's own account entered on it |

The plan's notice window, cosmetic window, decision time, exclusion list and proration ladder are the figures of the plan's schedules. Full years since coverage start count a year only once its anniversary date has been reached, from the coverage start date to the claim filing date.

## Notice window — boundary (hypothetical 30-day window)

The customer first noticed the problem on 3 March. Day one of the window is 4 March, and day thirty is 2 April.
- Filed on 2 April: on time (the last day of the window).
- Filed on 3 April: not filed within the window, so not considered under the terms.

## Decision by term

| Component term on the filing date | Labor term on the filing date | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| inside | inside | approved for parts and labor |
| inside | past | approved for parts only |
| past | either | denied as out of term |

An excluded cause gives denied for an excluded cause in every row. An installation workmanship claim is decided on the workmanship term alone.

## Proration — case (hypothetical)

An insulated glass claim under the Ridgeline Limited Warranty filed after 6 full years: the proration ladder sets a customer share above zero from 5 full years, so the decision is approved with proration.
